nuggets.text: The Eagles and Steelers merged for the 1943 season as the 'Steagles' after both lost many players to World War II service.
The Eagles became the first NFC East team to repeat as division champions since the 2004 Eagles.
Nick Sirianni played wide receiver at Division III Mount Union and won national titles in 2000, 2001 and 2002.
Nick Sirianni's brother Mike is a head coach too, at Washington & Jefferson College.
Sean Mannion is the fourth offensive coordinator the Eagles have hired in the last four seasons.
Saquon Barkley won Super Bowl LIX on his 28th birthday.
Saquon Barkley once hurdled a Jaguars defender backward, leaping over cornerback Jarrian Jones in 2024.
Makai Lemon was on the phone with the Steelers' GM, who planned to pick him 21st, when the Eagles called to take him 20th.
Rookie Eli Stowers won both the Mackey Award for the nation's best tight end and the Campbell Trophy for academics and football.
The Eagles' logo is patterned into the dark green upper-deck seats at Lincoln Financial Field.
